classification: PREPARATION ONLY baseline diagnosis, no source optimization/candidate/population
insufficient_policy: Keep every fixed row; insufficient stays insufficient; no repeat/retune
sample_scope: Hooks immediately after original start timestamp and before original elapsed timestamp around selected operation, after warmup/expected-work preparation; signal boundary/hook code can be sampled. No fixture setup/warmup/post-oracle inside bracket.
scan_semantics: Scan may emit duplicate entries. Preserve canonical actual emitted operations, checksum, traversals and independent full byte/score/coverage oracle; no n-only replacement.
metrics: PC counts/locations only; no cycles, cache costs, latency, speed or unbiased time-share claims
authorization: Root and distinct independent PASS, published exact freeze ACK, exclusive idle runner, no captures during preparation
backend: Inherited Codex/GPT-6 family; exact serving model/token/currency cost unknown
parent_watchdog: One parent SIGALRM at min(phase600s, absolute07:15UTC) minus10s cleanup reserve; handler enters owned-group cleanup/final status, including interruption during derive/serialization. SIGALRM is blocked through each mandatory child cleanup and journal write; pending expiry is delivered after the owned group is checked and recorded.
symbol_aliases: Own-image bins retain every coalesced alias and mark ambiguity; no unique cold-symbol attribution from an ambiguous PC.
